top_signals.title: Gold Advances as Strong Auction Demand Lowers Treasury Yields
top_signals.summary: Gold advanced as oil fell and an auction of 30-year US debt on Thursday drew solid demand, helping to pull long-dated yields from the highest levels in more than two decades.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: World’s Top Crude Trader Isn’t Ruling Out $200 Oil Just Yet
top_signals.summary: Ship-to-ship transfers in the Gulf of Oman that keep oil flowing from the Middle East provide a lifeline to Gulf producers and to the oil market, according to Russell Hardy, chief executive officer at the world’s biggest independent oil trader, Vitol Group. “Without it, you do have that $200-a-barrel scenario, so it is pretty important it continues,” Hardy said at the Energy Intelligence Forum in London this week. “There aren’t any more inventories to drain in the West.” The ship-to-ship (STS) transfers, in which…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Money Doesn’t Want to Leave Equities, Says Baird Strategas’ Verrone
top_signals.summary: Chris Verrone, partner and chief market strategist at Baird Strategas, sees equity markets as “highly rotational” and doesn’t think bond yields are high enough to be “truly competitive for your capital every day.” He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
